title: A website-opportunity demo whose agent turn failed or hung ends as failed with a reason and Retry
steps: S1: File moment follow-ups for an open turn and answer them failed, expired, unreadable and done-but-not-recorded with followThrough; take a moment the host refused through POST /api/sites/:key/moment.
S2: A client-send demo action whose agent turn ended in error before any provision: answer its moment job failed, drain the demo runner, then accept a Retry.
S3: Same action, its turn marked stale with no end reason; then a failed QA verdict with no provision job.
S4: Hang the action's run with its heartbeat alive, move accepted_at back 3 h, tick; accept a Retry; release the hung run. Separately tick with the queue switch off.
S5: A provision that succeeded, then the agent turn closes with error.
S6: Read demoFailureKey and nextAction for failed demo actions carrying each new code.

S7: For a failed action, set on its build the previous attempt's failed check, passed machine check, unchecked turn end or failed provision; accept a Retry, prepare it and drain before its brief is sent. Then send it with the old provision failure, and again once that failure is the Retry's own.
S8: A failed latest action over a build whose check passed: read the list stage, nextAction, ProgressCell and Steps.
S9: demoFailureKey for every code a failed demo action can carry, and for an unknown or empty code.

S10: Over a build whose older check passed, make the latest action each status wo_demo_action can hold (queued, completed, failed and their quality-*-v1 twins); read the list stage and attention, the client stageOf/statusView/nextAction and both progress cells for a queued and a running Retry, and the operator customerStatus for the raw statuses.

S11: Over a build still provisioning from 42 hours ago, fail the latest action (AGENT_DEMO_TURN_STOPPED, then DEMO_STEP_TIMEOUT) and read the list's Demo column facts and demoView; then queue a Retry accepted 3 minutes ago and read them again.
expect: S1: each turn is closed with its end reason, head_sha null and files 0; the turnClosed listener fires once per turn.
S2: the action is failed with AGENT_DEMO_TURN_STOPPED and the Retry is accepted (202).
S3: failed with AGENT_DEMO_TURN_LOST (end_reason stays null), then failed with AGENT_DEMO_ENDED_UNCHECKED.
S4: failed with DEMO_STEP_TIMEOUT; the late result changes neither the old action nor the queued Retry; with the switch off it is still DEMO_STEP_TIMEOUT.
S5: the action fails with AGENT_DEMO_TURN_STOPPED and wo_build.state stays done.
S6: each code maps to its reason.* key, an unknown code to null, and the next action is retry-demo.
S7: the Retry stays queued with no error in all four cases and after its send; it fails with PROVISION_FAILED only once the failed provision is its own.
S8: stage demo with attention, nextAction retry-demo (even from a server stage outreach), and both cells draw reason.demo_step_timeout, not v3.demoReady.
S9: every code maps to a reason key present in the English strings, none to reason.other; unknown or empty codes read reason.demo_failed.

S10: only a completed action (or none) reaches Outreach; queued or failed stays in Demo, a failed or quality-failed-v1 one with attention; the queued Retry reads Building with its step, never Demo ready or send-demo; the operator label matches the customer one for every raw status.
S11: the failed action's Demo column reads failed, never building; the queued Retry's reads building with startedAt equal to the Retry's accepted_at and 3 minutes, not the first build's 42 hours.
evidence: A demo stayed on Building after its agent ended in error: the moment job failed on a site with no webroot, the turn stayed open and the action never ended.
fence: door-follow-up WORK.moment closes the turn however the job ended; client-demo stopCode; expireOverdueDemoActions before every demo-runner tick
